purpose: Keep V2 source history scientifically meaningful, low-churn, recoverable, and automation-friendly.

commit_policy.default: One commit per coherent verified change or material milestone, not per shell command, tiny edit, health sample, game, or transient runtime event.
commit_policy.before_push: Use fixup/amend/autosquash for local micro-corrections when the commit has not been externally referenced.
commit_policy.after_push_or_scientific_binding: Do not rewrite commits whose SHA is already pushed as shared authority or bound into experiment/provenance identities.
commit_policy.runtime_state: Do not commit per-game counters, heartbeats, transient health state, temporary checkpoints, or operational log churn. Persist those in runtime/object-storage state.
commit_policy.negative_results: Preserve scientifically meaningful negative/inconclusive results in provenance without creating gratuitous commits.

branch_policy.feature_or_fix_branches: Use only for genuinely isolated work, risky fixes, or parallel experiments; do not create a branch for trivial edits.
branch_policy.scientific_epoch_branches: A commit already used as an experiment identity is immutable. Preserve that SHA when integrating or retain it through an explicit tag/reference.
branch_policy.cleanup: Delete obsolete short-lived branches after integration/rejection once no unique evidence or referenced commit would be lost.

merge_policy.ordinary_changes: Prefer squash integration after local fixups so one logical change becomes one mainline commit.
merge_policy.scientifically_referenced_commits: Preserve referenced SHAs; use an integration method that does not rewrite them.
merge_policy.rebase_merges: Avoid for commits already referenced by provenance because rebasing changes commit identity.
merge_policy.merge_commits: Use only when preserving meaningful branch/experiment lineage justifies the extra commit.

push_policy.default: Push verified material checkpoints, not every local edit.

main_rules.note: Do not require PR-only writes until the autonomous GitHub App/PR path is proven; direct fast-forward deploy-key pushes remain required for FULL-AFK continuity. Once that path is proven, require CI on PRs.
